articles.title: US county sues to block Trump's Triumphal Arch project
articles.titleCn: 美国一县起诉阻止特朗普凯旋门项目
articles.summary: Local authorities in Arlington County, Virginia, on Thursday sued to block construction of US President Donald Trump's planned Triumphal Arch project.

Arlington County is located in Northern Virginia just across the Potomac River from Washington, DC. The county government filed the lawsuit in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia, arguing that the Trump administration's planned 250-foot-tall arch {{3}} environmental laws and {{4}} further review. "As {{5}}, the Arch will dwarf Paris's Arc de Triomphe and directly {{6}} the line of sight between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery that was {{7}} created to {{8}} the nation's post-Civil War {{9}}," the complaint said.

In early September, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced on social media that excavation work could begin over the next two weeks.
paragraphs.cn: 最近，特朗普宣布这座凯旋门将作为“顶级军事综合体/凯旋门”，用于储存大量弹药，并“容纳、储存并具备快速使用大量无人机以及狙击手的能力”。9月初，内政部长道格·伯格姆在社交媒体上宣布，挖掘工作可能在未来两周内开始。

articles.fullText:
President Donald Trump holds up a model of the proposed triumphal arch as he addresses a dinner for donors who have contributed to build the new ballroom at the White House, October 15, 2025, in Washington, DC. 
Local authorities in Arlington County, Virginia, on Thursday sued to block construction of US President Donald Trump's planned Triumphal Arch project.
Arlington County is located in Northern Virginia just across the Potomac River from Washington, DC.
The county government filed the lawsuit in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia, arguing that the Trump administration's planned 250-foot-tall arch violates environmental laws and requires further review.
"As contemplated, the Arch will dwarf Paris's Arc de Triomphe and directly obstruct the line of sight between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery that was deliberately created to symbolize the nation's post-Civil War reunification," the complaint said.
Construction of the arch on Memorial Circle will "cause significant harm" to Arlington County and its residents, as the site lies within a busy traffic corridor, according to the five-person Arlington County Board.
The complaint also noted that construction of the arch will "harm public safety" in Arlington by clogging thoroughfares needed for emergency transport services.
"It threatens to increase noise and air pollution in Arlington by necessitating the diversion of certain flights into and out of Reagan National Airport," it continued.
According to the complaint, the National Park Service failed to take a "hard look" at the environmental impacts of the arch project, as required by law.
The county filed the lawsuit to halt the agency's "feverish pace" toward construction of the arch and to ensure that the "hard look" mandated by the National Environmental Policy Act is completed before the agency commences "disruptive and harmful ground-disturbing activities."
Trump first unveiled the administration's plan to construct the arch in October 2025, at the time hailing it as a monument to the 250th anniversary of American independence.
More recently, Trump announced the arch would serve as a "top-grade Military Complex/Triumphal Arch," which will store large quantities of ammunition and "house, store, and have the rapid ability to use large numbers of drones, plus Snipers."
In early September, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced on social media that excavation work could begin over the next two weeks.

articles.fullText:
Lesotho has confirmed a measles outbreak in its northern districts of Butha-Buthe and Leribe, with 12 confirmed and 20 suspected cases as of September 30, according to health authorities.
Mants'oanelo Monyobi, deputy principal secretary in the Ministry of Health, said in a statement that the outbreak was first detected on September 23 at Dr Strong Thabo Makenete Hospital in Butha-Buthe, where four suspected cases were identified. The National Reference Laboratory confirmed measles in three of the samples two days later.
The initial confirmed cases involved school-going children aged six to 14 from the Urban, Likila and Nqoe community councils in Butha-Buthe. By September 30, the district's tally had risen to 12 confirmed and 14 suspected cases.
Meanwhile, the neighboring Leribe district reported six suspected cases among children aged 13 to 15 in the Maputsoe Community Council.
Rapid response teams in both northern districts have launched contact tracing and active case finding, while health workers are providing treatment and enforcing infection prevention and control measures.
Monyobi noted that the health ministry is also assessing local vaccination coverage to identify gaps and guide targeted catch-up immunization campaigns.
Measles is a highly contagious viral disease spread through respiratory droplets. Symptoms typically appear seven to 18 days after exposure and include fever, a red rash, cough, a runny nose, and red or watery eyes.
Monyobi warned that measles can lead to severe complications such as pneumonia, severe diarrhea, ear infections, brain inflammation, and even death. Young children, pregnant women, and individuals suffering from malnutrition or vitamin A deficiency are particularly vulnerable.
Urging parents to keep their children's routine vaccinations up to date, Monyobi emphasized that measles-containing vaccines are both safe and highly effective. She also advised anyone showing symptoms to isolate from schools, workplaces, and public gatherings, and to seek immediate medical attention.

articles.title: Discover music and ancient civilizations in Beijing
articles.titleCn: 在北京探索音乐与古代文明
articles.summary: The Beijing Music Festival and the Capital Museum have teamed up to offer holders of Beijing Music Festival ticket stubs discounted admission to the exhibition "Maize, Gold and Jaguar – A Grand Exhibition of Ancient Maya and Andean Civilizations," giving audiences an opportunity to explore different cultures through music and history.

articles.fullText:
The main structure of China's first offshore carbon injection project has been completed, with the new central platform for the Dongfang 1-1 gas field entering the commissioning stage, October 4, 2026. /CMG
The main structure of China's first offshore carbon injection project has been completed, as the new central platform for the Dongfang 1-1 gas field enters the commissioning stage on Sunday.
The demonstration project is designed to inject captured carbon dioxide into underground formations to boost natural gas production. Once operational, it will be able to permanently store more than 1 million tonnes of CO2 each year, supporting large-scale emissions reduction in China's offshore energy industry.
The central platform weighs nearly 17,000 tonnes and rises more than 28 stories high, with a total deck area of over 10,000 square meters, equivalent to nearly 22 standard basketball courts.
The platform will capture and purify CO2 produced alongside natural gas, then compress and inject it back into underground formations. The process can both improve the recovery of hard-to-extract natural gas and permanently store CO2.
The Dongfang 1-1 gas field is China's first offshore self-operated gas field and a major offshore gas field with high CO2 content. Since production began in 2003, it has produced more than 50 billion cubic meters of natural gas.
As the gas field enters the later stage of development, natural gas production has declined while CO2 content has increased, providing conditions for the application of carbon injection technology.
Once fully operational, the project will inject more than 1 million tonnes of CO2 into underground formations annually, marking the first large-scale offshore application of carbon injection technology in China and promoting the resource utilization of CO2 in industry.
articles.fullTextCn:
中国首个海上碳注入项目主体结构已完工，东方1-1气田新建中心平台于周日进入调试阶段。该示范项目旨在将捕集的二氧化碳注入地下地层以提高天然气产量。一旦投入运营，它每年将能够永久封存超过100万吨二氧化碳，支持中国海上能源产业的大规模减排。该中心平台重近17000吨，高逾28层楼，总甲板面积超过1万平方米，相当于近22个标准篮球场。

该平台将捕集并净化与天然气一同产出的二氧化碳，然后将其压缩并回注到地下地层中。这一过程既能提高难以开采的天然气的采收率，又能永久封存二氧化碳。东方1-1气田是中国首个海上自营气田，也是一个高二氧化碳含量的重要海上气田。自2003年投产以来，它已生产超过500亿立方米天然气。随着该气田进入开发后期，天然气产量下降而二氧化碳含量上升，为碳注入技术的应用提供了条件。

一旦全面投入运营，该项目每年将向地下地层注入超过100万吨二氧化碳，标志着碳注入技术在中国首次实现大规模海上应用，并推动二氧化碳在工业中的资源化利用。
